examples.title: Inspect the date column in the sorted file
examples.sql:
SELECT row_group_id, row_group_num_rows AS rows,
       stats_min_value AS first_day, stats_max_value AS last_day
FROM parquet_metadata(getvariable('sorted_file'))
WHERE path_in_schema = 'event_day' ORDER BY row_group_id;

examples.title: Inspect the same records interleaved across row groups
examples.sql:
SELECT row_group_id, row_group_num_rows AS rows,
       stats_min_value AS first_day, stats_max_value AS last_day
FROM parquet_metadata(getvariable('mixed_file'))
WHERE path_in_schema = 'event_day' ORDER BY row_group_id;

examples.title: Both layouts answer the same filter
examples.sql:
SELECT 'sorted' AS layout, count(*) AS matching_rows
FROM read_parquet(getvariable('sorted_file')) WHERE event_day = DATE '2026-01-02'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'mixed', count(*)
FROM read_parquet(getvariable('mixed_file')) WHERE event_day = DATE '2026-01-02';

sampleSpecs.title: One dataset, two physical layouts
sampleSpecs.description: First eight of 8,192 rows. Each of the four days has exactly 2,048 events. The downloads contain the complete data.

challenge.title: Find groups that could contain January 3
challenge.prompt: Return row_group_id for groups in sorted_file whose event_day statistics do not rule out January 3. Retain groups with missing or unparseable bounds.
challenge.hint: Keep a group when its minimum is on/before the date and its maximum is on/after it. A missing bound cannot prove exclusion.
challenge.starter:
SELECT row_group_id
FROM parquet_metadata(getvariable('sorted_file'))
WHERE path_in_schema = 'event_day'
ORDER BY row_group_id;
challenge.solution:
SELECT row_group_id
FROM parquet_metadata(getvariable('sorted_file'))
WHERE path_in_schema = 'event_day'
  AND (TRY_CAST(stats_min_value AS DATE) IS NULL
       OR TRY_CAST(stats_min_value AS DATE) <= DATE '2026-01-03')
  AND (TRY_CAST(stats_max_value AS DATE) IS NULL
       OR TRY_CAST(stats_max_value AS DATE) >= DATE '2026-01-03')
ORDER BY row_group_id;
challenge.success: Only group 2 can contain January 3 in this sorted fixture. The metadata describes skip opportunities, not measured bytes saved.
